components.purpose: The 'Ready to try it?' section halfway down the product page: Heading = 'Ready to try it?', Primary Button = 'Start free trial' (Link field). It is the only component needed. It has a heading and button and is a full-width call-to-action band, so it covers the whole request. Its agent guidance places it at body or bottom, which suits mid-page. Leave the Description, Secondary Button and Background Image empty unless you want them. Leave Background at 'brand' (the default) or choose 'dark'.
